Plain handler results default to HTTP 200 unless another status is declared. HttpResponse values choose their own status. Unhandled request failures return HTTP 500 and cancel the request tasks.

<a id="symbol-authorize"></a>
## `authorize` · [source](authorization.aug#L12)

`authorize` handles `GET /provider/authorize`. Validate the registered client before offering a login form. A malformed redirect is never followed.

It takes labeled inputs `response_type`, `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `requestedScope`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge`, and `code_challenge_method`. It gets `crypto` ([`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto)), `clock` ([`Clock`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock)), and `requests` ([`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest>`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore)) from dependency injection.

It gets `config` from [`settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-settings). It checks that `client_id` equals `config.clientId` and `redirect_uri` equals `config.callback` and `response_type` equals `"code"` and `code_challenge_method` equals `"S256"`, `requestedScope` is either `"openid"` or `"openid profile"`, and `state` is a URL-safe ASCII token with `43` to `128` characters and `nonce` is a URL-safe ASCII token with `43` to `128` characters and the byte length of `code_challenge` equals `43`. It raises a [`LoginError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginError) at the first failed check. [source](authorization.aug#L13-L19)

It checks that the byte length of [`crypto.decodeBase64url`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.decodeBase64url) with `input` from `code_challenge` equals `32`. It raises a [`LoginError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginError) at the first failed check. If this work raises `CryptoError`, it raises a [`LoginError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginError). It sets `requestId`, `browser`, and `csrf` separately, each to the URL-safe base64 encoding of [`crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) with `size` `32`. [source](authorization.aug#L20-L27)

It sets `now` to [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now). It sets `request` to an [`AuthorizationRequest`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-AuthorizationRequest) with `clientId` from `client_id`, `redirectUri` from `redirect_uri`, `state`, `nonce`, `challenge` from `code_challenge`, `browser`, `csrf`, and `expires` from `now` plus `300`. It calls [`requests.put`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put) with `key` from `requestId`, `value` from `request`, `request.expires`, and `now`. It sets `headers` to [`withCookie`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-withCookie) with `headers` from [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders), `name` `"aug_authorize"`, `value` from `browser`, `path` `"/provider"`, `maxAge` `300`, and `secure` from `config.secureCookies`. [source](authorization.aug#L28-L31)

It returns HTTP 200 with [`ProviderLogin`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderLogin) with `requestId`, `csrf`, `message` `"Authorize the registered August login app."`, and `submit` from a form action that sends `POST /provider/login` to [`providerLogin`](authorization.aug.md#symbol-providerLogin) on submission and `headers` headers. [source](authorization.aug#L32)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
authorize(string response_type, string client_id, string redirect_uri, string requestedScope, string state, string nonce, string code_challenge, string code_challenge_method, resolve Crypto crypto, resolve Clock clock, resolve ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest> requests) returns HttpResponse<Html> unless CryptoError and HttpError and LoginError and StoreFull and TimeError uses Crypto.decodeBase64url, Crypto.random, Clock.now, ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest>.put
```

It reads `response_type`, `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `scope`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge`, and `code_challenge_method` from the HTTP query. `scope` is called `requestedScope` here. It gets `crypto` ([`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto)), `clock` ([`Clock`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock)), and `requests` ([`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest>`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore)) from dependency injection. The handler responds with HTTP 400 for [`LoginError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginError), HTTP 503 for `CryptoError`, HTTP 503 for `TimeError`, and HTTP 503 for [`StoreFull`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-StoreFull).

It can also raise `HttpError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-providerLogin"></a>
## `providerLogin` · [source](authorization.aug#L35)

`providerLogin` handles `POST /provider/login`. The browser binding and CSRF token are checked before credentials. Each form request is consumed once.

It takes labeled inputs `form`, `browser`, and `origin`. It gets `crypto` ([`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto)), `clock` ([`Clock`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock)), `requests` ([`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest>`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore)), and `codes` ([`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationCode>`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore)) from dependency injection.

It gets `config` from [`settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-settings). If `origin` does not equal `config.baseUrl`, it returns HTTP 403 with [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) showing `"The sign-in form must come from this app."` and [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) headers. It obtains [`requests.take`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take) with `key` from `form.request_id` and `now` from [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now). If no value is found, it returns HTTP 400 with [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) showing `"The sign-in request expired or was already used."` and [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) headers. [source](authorization.aug#L36-L60)

The non-null result becomes `request`. If `browser` is null, it returns HTTP 403 with [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) showing `"The browser binding is missing."` and [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) headers. The non-null `browser` becomes `secret`. If [`crypto.equal`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal) with `left` from the UTF-8 bytes of `secret` and `right` from the UTF-8 bytes of `request.browser` returns false or [`crypto.equal`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal) with `left` from the UTF-8 bytes of `form.csrf` and `right` from the UTF-8 bytes of `request.csrf` returns false, it returns HTTP 403 with [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) showing `"The sign-in form could not be verified."` and [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) headers. [source](authorization.aug#L37-L60)

If [`verifyCredentials`](credentials.aug.md#symbol-verifyCredentials) with `form.username` and `form.password` using injected `crypto` returns false, it returns HTTP 401 with [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) showing `"The username or password was not accepted."` and [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) headers. It sets `now` to [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now). It sets `code` to the URL-safe base64 encoding of [`crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) with `size` `32`. It sets `grant` to an [`AuthorizationCode`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-AuthorizationCode) with `request.clientId`, `request.redirectUri`, `request.challenge`, `request.nonce`, `subject` `"demo-ada"`, `name` `"Ada"`, and `expires` from `now` plus `60`. [source](authorization.aug#L50-L54)

It calls [`codes.put`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put) with `key` from `code`, `value` from `grant`, `grant.expires`, and `now`. It builds `location` as the text `{request.redirectUri}?code={urlEncode with input from code}&state={urlEncode with input from request.state}`. It sets `headers` to [`withCookie`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-withCookie) with `headers` from [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) with the header `"location"` set to `location`, `name` `"aug_authorize"`, `value` `""`, `path` `"/provider"`, `maxAge` `0`, and `secure` from `config.secureCookies`. It returns HTTP 303 with a paragraph containing `Returning to the application.` with escaped text and `headers` headers. [source](authorization.aug#L55-L58)

If this work raises `HttpError`, it returns HTTP 400 with [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) showing `"The submitted form is invalid."` and [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) headers. [source](authorization.aug#L60)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
providerLogin(LoginForm form, optional string browser, optional string origin, resolve Crypto crypto, resolve Clock clock, resolve ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest> requests, resolve ExpiringStore<AuthorizationCode> codes) returns HttpResponse<Html> unless CryptoError and HttpError and StoreFull and TimeError uses Clock.now, ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest>.take, Crypto.equal, Crypto.random, ExpiringStore<AuthorizationCode>.put, Crypto.passwordHash, Crypto.decodeBase64url
```

It takes `form` as [`LoginForm`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginForm) from the HTTP form, `browser` as `optional string` from the HTTP cookie `aug_authorize`, and `origin` as `optional string` from the HTTP header `origin`. It gets `crypto` ([`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto)), `clock` ([`Clock`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock)), `requests` ([`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationRequest>`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore)), and `codes` ([`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationCode>`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore)) from dependency injection. Omitted optional inputs are null. The handler responds with HTTP 503 for `CryptoError`, HTTP 503 for `TimeError`, and HTTP 503 for [`StoreFull`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-StoreFull).

It can also raise `HttpError`.

</details>

## Dependencies

It uses [`ExpiringStore`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore) ([`put`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put) and [`take`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take)) and [`StoreFull`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_0eb7c89453c87681ed15/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/store.aug.md#symbol-StoreFull) from `memory`. It uses [`urlEncode`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_897efafd565158fc4908/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-urlEncode) from `web`. It uses [`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto) ([`decodeBase64url`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.decodeBase64url), [`equal`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal), [`passwordHash`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.passwordHash), and [`random`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_9ef654c66d34ab8f5527/0.0.0-git.b14a0f9aa41f1ce58bd51133bcdc424033e40d40/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random)) from `crypto`. It uses [`Clock`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock) ([`now`](../.aug-spec/packages/%40git/url_c092cd151499c4e1d8a1/0.0.0-git.a39fc582565d4fca40be4f75fa304d71adc69301/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now)) from `time`.

It uses [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders), [`withCookie`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-withCookie), and [`settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-settings) from `common`. It uses [`Settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-Settings) (`baseUrl`, `callback`, `clientId`, and `secureCookies`). It uses [`AuthorizationCode`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-AuthorizationCode) (`expires`), [`AuthorizationRequest`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-AuthorizationRequest) (`browser`, `challenge`, `clientId`, `csrf`, `expires`, `nonce`, `redirectUri`, and `state`), [`LoginError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginError), and [`LoginForm`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginForm) (`csrf`, `password`, `request_id`, and `username`) from `contracts`. It uses [`verifyCredentials`](credentials.aug.md#symbol-verifyCredentials) from `credentials`.

It uses [`ProviderFailure`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderFailure) and [`ProviderLogin`](views.aug.md#symbol-ProviderLogin) from `views`.

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
